title: GZCLP: UPPER/LOWER Athlete Focus
author: Dean Daoud
desc:
Rules: 

Put 85% of your 3 rep max as your 1RM to begin.

Increase squat and deadlifts T1 by 5kg weekly
Increase bench T1 2.5kg weekly
Increase OHP T1 1.25 weekly 
Once you fail a week of 5x3 move onto 6x2 (with the sixth set being an AMRAP)
Once you fail a week of 6x2 move onto 10x1 (with the tenth set being an AMRAP)
Once you fail that, take a deload and retest your 5 rep max and start T1 again

Increase squat and deadlifts T2 by 2-5kg weekly
Increase chin-up T2 1-2kg weekly
Increase machine row T2 2.5kg weekly
Once you fail a week of 3x10 move onto 3x8 
Once you fail a week of 3x8 move onto 3x6 
Once you fail that, take a deload and retest your 5 rep max and start T2 again

For T3 do 2x15 of the same weight and 1 AMRAP. When you get 25 reps on the AMRAP, increase the weight by the smallest amount possible.

Recommendation:

- Eat at least maintenance calories.
- Eat at least 0.9g protein per lbs of body weight
- Do cardio on at least 1 rest day. I would recommend swimming.
